currentFormal.sourceSemantics: marketCapYi may be explicit external enrichment or fallback sharesOutstanding*close/1e8; provenance is not serialized in current Shadow.

structuralWitness.conclusion: 10bn is a hard discontinuity independent of continuous liquidity/quality once the 10-30bn special conditions are otherwise met.

taiwanSizeEffect2026.citation: Ko et al., Pacific-Basin Finance Journal 96 (2026), 103021, DOI 10.1016/j.pacfin.2025.103021
taiwanSizeEffect2026.retainedFinding: Taiwan size effect is weak/inconclusive unconditionally and time-varying; illiquidity and limit-hit frequency/limits-to-arbitrage explain important variation.
taiwanSizeEffect2026.guard: Does not imply microcaps should be admitted into this short-horizon selector.

momentumReview2023.citation: Jegadeesh & Titman, Pacific-Basin Finance Journal 82 (2023), 102202, DOI 10.1016/j.pacfin.2023.102202
momentumReview2023.retainedFinding: Taiwan momentum becomes more evident when small-cap and low-priced stocks are excluded.
momentumReview2023.guard: Supports a plausible protective size/price filter but does not validate the exact NT$1bn market-cap cutoff.

taiwanOtcLiquidity.citation: Common factors in liquidity: Evidence from Taiwan's OTC stock market
taiwanOtcLiquidity.retainedFinding: Smaller firms are more sensitive to market-wide liquidity changes and may have higher information asymmetry.
taiwanOtcLiquidity.guard: Size may proxy liquidity risk; incremental effect after direct liquidity controls remains the key question.

shadowAudit.BROAD_CONTROL: Can incidentally sample <10bn names only if historyDays>=60, close>=10 and avgVolume20Lots>=minLots, but is capped at 6 per price pool and not cap-stratified.
shadowAudit.REJECTED_AFTER_BASE: Cannot capture because market-cap floor returns basePassed=false.
shadowAudit.historyWarmup: Ad-hoc chooseHistoryWarmupTargets excludes marketCapYi<10, but the main runHistorySeed/buildHistorySeedQueue does NOT apply a market-cap floor and can populate complete history for <10bn names. Therefore history starvation is not assumed.
shadowAudit.currentSnapshotGap: buildResearchSnapshot does not serialize marketCapYi or market-cap source/basis, so existing saved controls cannot measure continuous distance below the 10bn cutoff.

proposedProspectiveCohort.population: marketCapYi<10, price>=10, history/source valid, with exact first rejection reason and no decision impact
requiredFields: official exact limit state when available

primaryQuestion: Among stocks on common support for executable liquidity and other observable risk controls, does marketCapYi<10bn add independent downside/non-follow-through risk beyond liquidity, price, volatility, limit-hit and information-quality variables?
comparisons: Continuous marketCapYi within <10bn where captured; do not immediately bucket/tune new cutoffs.
Matched <10bn versus 10-30bn stocks satisfying common liquidity/price/sector/regime controls.
Separate explicit market-cap source from sharesOutstanding*close-derived values.
Within-date D1/D3/D5/D10/D20, MFE, MAE, stop/no-follow-through proxies, later A/B setup incidence.
falsification: If sub-10bn names remain materially worse after strong liquidity/execution/limit-state/information controls, retain the floor.
If apparent small-cap return premium is concentrated in illiquid/high-limit-hit names, reject floor relaxation for this selector.
If liquid sub-10bn names show stable OOS continuation/opportunity benefit without worse downside/cost and size adds no residual risk, surface a future floor-reformulation candidate.
If momentum quality improves merely by excluding small/low-priced stocks, treat the floor as potentially protective rather than redundant.
Do not historically recompute market cap using current sharesOutstanding.

engineeringBoundary.capture: Potential Class A if only already-loaded marketCap/liquidity/context fields are serialized into isolated research storage with zero source calls and no Formal impact.
engineeringBoundary.provenanceRepair: Class B proposal-first if marketCap source/vintage requires shared enrichment or corporate-action denominator work.

optimizationBridge.promotionPrerequisite: Prospective matched/OOS evidence must show the 10bn floor is redundant after executable-liquidity and risk controls and that admission does not worsen downside/cost/zero-pick behavior.
